objective: Prüfen, ob die sechs in Q011 fixierten GDELT-Features überwiegend redundante Messungen gemeinsamer Event-Intensität sind oder im längeren Q012-Fenster unterschiedliche Mechanismusinformation tragen.

design.primary_observation_unit: common market-day observations from the fixed Q012 window
diagnostics: feature-feature Spearman correlation matrix over all common observations
feature-feature Spearman correlation matrix restricted to event windows
asset-feature return association table for next-day and five-day horizons over all observations
same association table restricted to event windows
fixed mechanism-group contrast summary without feature selection

interpretation_guardrails: No feature may be chosen because it has the largest observed relationship.
Collinearity or redundancy is descriptive; it is not evidence that any mechanism is causal.
Sparse event-only cells must be reported as data insufficiency, not repaired by pooling or dropping blocks.
Any later performance hypothesis requires a new preregistration, fresh symbol-disjoint coverage and unchanged evidence gates.
preregistration_decision_rule: Q013 does not authorize performance. It only determines whether the fixed Q011 feature set contains sufficiently distinguishable descriptive mechanism signals to justify a separate future hypothesis.
